data.body: **[P1] Keep payload failures out of `withRetry`.** This is an `Exception`, so `DurableContextImpl.executeRetryLoop` feeds nested operation load/offload failures into the user retry strategy. It can consequently checkpoint a backoff or rerun user operations instead of propagating the invocation-level storage failure, risking duplicate side effects. Explicitly rethrow `PayloadOffloadException` alongside the existing suspension/unrecoverable control signals, with first-execution and replay regression tests.
